Healthy.symptoms: Leaves are vibrant green with no spots or discoloration.
Healthy.treatment: Keep maintaining good care, regular watering, and appropriate sunlight.
Healthy.prevention: Ensure soil quality and regular monitoring.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powdery spots on leaves and stems, stunted growth.
Powdery Mildew.causes: Fungal infection caused by high humidity and poor air circulation.
Powdery Mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur-based fungicides or baking soda solution. Remove infected parts.
Powdery Mildew.prevention: Water at the base, space plants for air flow, avoid overhead watering.

Rust.symptoms: Orange, yellow, or brown pustules on the undersides of leaves.
Rust.causes: Fungal infection thriving in moist conditions.
Rust.treatment: Remove infected leaves immediately. Apply copper-based fungicides.
Rust.prevention: Avoid wetting leaves when watering. Ensure good air circulation around plants.
